Nora C: Quick flag 1: SI partner wants to bundle our Hosted model as part of their managed integration product. Vendor contract says no third-party hosting. Can we permit SI to resell access?
Diego S: they mean they want to white-label our API and include it in their dashboard, right? That's different from giving weights away.
Raj (SI): correct. We want to offer "Model powered" feature in our SaaS bundle; customers call our endpoint which proxies to Redwood. We won't store weights.
Mei L (Legal): paste the restriction?
Nora C: here it is:
```
No Third-Party Hosting or Sub-licensing: Licensee shall not host, operate, sublicense, or permit third parties to operate the Model or Model weights as a service without Provider's express written consent.
```
Mei L (Legal): narrow but workable. Provider only needs to control who hosts the model. White-label proxy by SI could be considered "third-party hosting" unless Provider consents.
Diego S: product question: do we need telemetry/attribution? We want usage visibility and to ensure quotas/SLAs flow through Redwood.
Raj (SI): we can route metering through Redwood and pass attribution headers. Customers expect single-sign on into our console.
Mei L (Legal): propose an addendum: allow "Authorized Integrator" sublicenses limited to proxying API calls with no access to raw weights, subject to partner onboarding, logging, and no sub-redistribution. Suggested text:
```
Authorized Integrator Clause: Provider may grant Licensee the right to permit designated Integrators to proxy inference requests to Provider's hosted service on Licensee's behalf, provided that (a) Integrators do not receive, store, or transfer model weight files; (b) Integrators are onboarded and certified by Provider; (c) all calls are metered and attributable to Licensee; and (d) Provider retains final control over billing and service termination.
```
Nora C: that's perfect 1 lets SI resell while Provider keeps control and visibility.
Diego S: ops note: need headers for partner_id and customer_id, and a way to tag traffic for billing.
Raj (SI): we'll add those headers and support SSO mapping. Also ok with certification requirements.
Mei L (Legal): I'll draft the clause + certification checklist (insurance, security questionnaire, audit rights, export compliance).
